text: Setting project goals is essential for success. One effective method is using SMART goals, which are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. These goals help your team stay focused and know exactly what to accomplish. It is also important to define milestones, which are key points in the project timeline, and deliverables, the final products or results you must provide. Finally, you need stakeholder alignment. This means making sure everyone involved, such as clients, managers, and team members, agrees on the goals and expectations from the start. When all these elements work together, your project is much more likely to succeed.
